title: Rotated matrix collage (Springs hero)
source: springs.estate — S1 hero. Extracted: desktop from library/components/rotated-mosaic-hero, mobile auto-drift from library/combos/springs-home/springs-engine.js (S18-F).
engine: A grid of photo tiles rotated as ONE rigid plane (~-9deg), bound by a colour multiply wash that unifies the disparate photos, that DRIFTS as one plane. Depth is free: the tilt makes top-row and bottom-row tiles travel a different screen-Y as the plane moves — no per-tile speed.
differs: Same static pose + same drift AXIS (translateY of the whole plane). What DIFFERS is the drift TRIGGER: desktop = scroll-linked (plane follows scroll position), mobile = auto-play over wall-clock time (plane drifts on its own at s=0, independent of scroll). This is empirically how springs behaves, not a guess — the mobile hero auto-drifts before any scroll input.

desktop.driver: scrollDrift — plane translateY = f(scroll progress). Measured live: plane Y 0 → -121px across the hero.
desktop.parity: component parent (rotated-mosaic-hero) gate CURTAIN PASS: 0 blank, 59.9fps, jank 1/685.

mobile.driver: autoDrift — plane translateY = f(wall-clock time), looped, ease-in-out. Measured live: item tx 531 → 766 → 1005 across ~12s at s=0.
mobile.parity: springs-engine mobile branch proven to 1.99% pixel-parity (S18-F, mobile-intro0, same-run timing extractor).
mobile.extras_on_mobile: On the live site mobile ALSO adds slider sections (wellness-slider, residences-slider, interiors-slider) that desktop renders as scroll sections — those are separate techniques, not part of this collage.

tiles.default: from .rmc-tile children or a tiles[] array

scale.what: plane scale so corners over-cover the viewport after rotation.

wash.what: opacity of the unifying multiply colour wash over the mosaic.

parallax.what: whole-plane drift across the scroll span.

autoDrift.what: distance the plane travels over one auto cycle.

entry: RotatedMatrixCollage.init(target, opts) -> { platform, plane, driver }. Markup: .rmc-stage > .rmc-bg + .rmc-plane(.rmc-grid + .rmc-wash) + .rmc-content. Pass opts.platform 'desktop'|'mobile' to force a branch (demos); default 'auto' reads matchMedia(min-width:1024px).
law: transform (plane translate/rotate/scale) + opacity only. The wash is mix-blend:multiply but BAKED INTO the static plane (whole plane transforms together — the one allowed mix-blend spot, catalog P18). GPU layer on the plane. reduced-motion → no drift on BOTH platforms. NO WebGL.
gate_mode: CURTAIN (a mosaic always shows many tile-renders at once; seam 100% is inherent, not a diptych bug). blank/jank/fps stay hard.
